# Mixkit cinematic impact layers

The following 320 kbps runtime files are used under the Mixkit Sound Effects Free License

- `organic-impact.mp3`
  - Mixkit item 788: Big cinematic impact
  - Source: https://mixkit.co/free-sound-effects/cinematic/
- `airfold-impact.mp3`
  - Mixkit item 1143: Cinematic whoosh deep impact
  - Source: https://mixkit.co/free-sound-effects/cinematic/
- `cinematic-drum-hit.mp3`
  - Mixkit item 546: Cinematic mystery trailer drum hit
  - Source: https://mixkit.co/free-sound-effects/cinematic/

License page: https://mixkit.co/license/

The game layers these sources with real-card foley, per-cue timing, music ducking and smooth tail fades
No source is redistributed as a standalone download inside the user interface
